control_flow: followInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 % (dark), steer by the line tracker's brightness (below 90 % curve left, above 90 % curve right, exactly 90 % call avoidWalls); else (bright) call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dark and an obstacle is on the left turn right 20°, else if dark and an obstacle is on the right turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; if bright call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dark drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left (10/40), else curve right (40/10).

'As before' for the light isn't spelled out: the program also stops at a wall in the light, which I took as inferred.
